questions.question: What was unusual about Momo's father?
questions.subject: Momo Nishimiya/Synopsis

answer.item: Her father was American and a jujutsu sorcerer, which is rare.

questions.question: How did Momo help her classmates during the Night Parade of a Hundred Demons?
questions.subject: Momo Nishimiya/Synopsis

answer.item: Momo helped her classmates locate cursed spirits in Kyoto by flying high in the air.

questions.question: Why did Momo keep her distance from Nobara during their fight?
questions.subject: Momo Nishimiya/Synopsis

answer.item: Momo continued to be cautious and made sure to keep her distance from Nobara because of what Noritoshi Kamo told her about Toge Inumaki's cursed speech.

questions.question: How did Nobara make Momo lose control of her broom?
questions.subject: Momo Nishimiya/Synopsis

answer.item: Nobara was able to grab a bristle from Momo's broom and used her Resonance technique on it, causing Momo to lose control of her broom and fall.

questions.question: What did Momo do when Pseudo-Geto used Uzumaki on Miwa?
questions.subject: Momo Nishimiya/Synopsis

answer.item: When Miwa's attack failed and Pseudo-Geto unleashed Uzumaki at point-blank range on her, Momo noticed and dove down to protect her.

questions.question: Why did Momo want to postpone the rule allowing communication between colonies?
questions.subject: Momo Nishimiya/Synopsis

answer.item: When asked why, Momo explained that Maki and Ui Ui could solve the communication problem due to their abilities.

questions.question: How did Momo watch Gojo's fight with Sukuna on December 24th?
questions.subject: Momo Nishimiya/Synopsis

answer.item: Momo and the rest of the jujutsu sorcerers watched the fight via broadcast inside Rika

questions.question: What did Momo admit after Maki finished scolding Yuta?
questions.subject: Momo Nishimiya/Synopsis

answer.item: Momo admitted to the sorcerers that she wished she could do more to help them, though Mei Mei commented that her broom was comfy and that was good enough.
